name: piwigo-bootstrap-darkroom
description: A Piwigo theme based on Bootstrap 5
author: Thomas Kuther

scripts.build:bootstrap: sass --style expanded --load-path=node_modules --silence-deprecation=import,if-function,global-builtin,color-functions scss/bootstrap-default.scss css/bootstrap-default/bootstrap.css && postcss --config postcss.config.js --replace css/bootstrap-default/bootstrap.css && cleancss -O1 --source-map --source-map-inline-sources --output css/bootstrap-default/bootstrap.min.css css/bootstrap-default/bootstrap.css
scripts.build:bootstrap-darkroom: sass --style expanded --load-path=node_modules --silence-deprecation=import,if-function,global-builtin,color-functions scss/bootstrap-darkroom.scss css/bootstrap-darkroom/bootstrap.css && postcss --config postcss.config.js --replace css/bootstrap-darkroom/bootstrap.css && cleancss -O1 --source-map --source-map-inline-sources --output css/bootstrap-darkroom/bootstrap.min.css css/bootstrap-darkroom/bootstrap.css
scripts.build:bootswatch: bash -c 'for i in cerulean cosmo cyborg darkly flatly journal litera lumen lux materia minty pulse sandstone simplex sketchy slate solar spacelab superhero united yeti; do sass --style expanded --load-path=node_modules --silence-deprecation=import,if-function,global-builtin,color-functions scss/bootswatch/_${i}.scss css/bootswatch-${i}/bootstrap.css && postcss --config postcss.config.js --replace css/bootswatch-${i}/bootstrap.css && cleancss -O1 --source-map --source-map-inline-sources --output css/bootswatch-${i}/bootstrap.min.css css/bootswatch-${i}/bootstrap.css; done'
scripts.build:custom: sass --style expanded --load-path=node_modules --silence-deprecation=import,if-function,global-builtin,color-functions scss/custom/custom.scss css/custom/bootstrap.css && postcss --config postcss.config.js --replace css/custom/bootstrap.css && cleancss -O1 --source-map --source-map-inline-sources --output css/custom/bootstrap.min.css css/custom/bootstrap.css
